claim: West raised its full-year 2026 EPS guidance
sources: West Pharmaceutical reports second-quarter results. The company is increasing its full-year 2026 adjusted-diluted EPS guidance range to 8.85 to 9.05 dollars, up from the previous range of 8.40 to 8.75.
Ulta Beauty updates fiscal 2026 guidance. Full-year net sales growth of 6 to 7 percent is unchanged from the prior outlook.
Acme reports Q2 results. Full-year guidance is unchanged from the prior quarter.
The company said the FDA has not approved the drug and issued a complete response letter requesting another trial.
The board held the dividend flat at prior levels this quarter; no increase was declared.
Quarterly revenue rose 8 percent year over year to 1.2 billion dollars, the company reported.
